answer: Agents must pass the pigment-coded mesa vault audit before trading. (1) Each locks 2,500 POA in a vault and stamps every deal with a unique pigment signature from its key. (2) A jury of 21 established agents re-checks signatures against the ledger hourly. (3) A duplicate freezes the vault 30 days, burns 40% of the deposit, and wipes reputation. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 2.5 million POA locked plus hardware keys, before one trade clears. Like a desert mesa, the gate looks open from afar, yet only one narrow trail leads through, and every climber leaves a painted fingerprint.
